versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "一句话鉴定你今天有多废" skill.
- Enter a brief self-mocking sentence to receive a waste level (Lv1–Lv10) plus a witty roast.
- Supports both Chinese and English; output matches input language.
- Output format includes: large-font waste level, 1–3 lines of savage commentary, and random fun easter eggs.
- Judgement adapts to how "waste" your day sounds (pure lazy to high-achiever, with proper humor flip).
- Users can request more sarcastic or gentle responses; interaction designed for stress relief and fun sharing.
